description: Payment notifications from Ko-fi - receive the webhook Ko-fi sends when a donation, membership payment, shop order or commission is paid, with every delivery verified against the account's token. Ko-fi publishes no REST API.

api.description: List the payment types Ko-fi can deliver, from its webhook reference; makes no API call, because Ko-fi has no REST API

fields.type: { type: string, description: string, docs_url: string }[]

webhooks.description: A paid commission. Ko-fi documents the type but publishes no example payload.

fields.description: The token from your Ko-fi webhooks page; the plugin handler compares it before accepting the payment.
Unique per delivery, and stable across a retry.
When the payment happened, ISO 8601. Ko-fi documents it as required.
The supporter’s display name, or `Anonymous`.
A decimal string, such as `5.00`, not a number. Ko-fi documents it as required.
A link to the transaction on Ko-fi.
Present only when the supporter shared it with the creator.
ISO 4217, such as `USD`. Ko-fi documents it as required.
Ko-fi’s transaction identifier. Ko-fi documents it as required.
The membership tier, on a Subscription only.

fields.type: { direct_link_code?: string | null, variation_name?: string | null, quantity?: number | null }[] | null
